g.text: Everything typed, up to and including Enter, goes into the input buffer:
std::cin >> a reads 7, then stops at the '.'
std::cin >> b can't make an int from ".5", so it fails
cin is now in a failed state, and every later >> is skipped.
• >> skips spaces and newlines, then reads one value
• leftover characters stay for the next >>
• a failed read sets the variable to 0 and blocks all later reads
